title: Live MODFLOW STO replacement versus additive duplicate storage

cases.name: UNREPLACED_MODFLOW_STORAGE
cases.role: control showing the configured MODFLOW storage governs head if the coupler does not replace it

cases.name: HLINK_STORAGE_REPLACEMENT
cases.role: coextensive h-link ownership control: one shared storage response is represented once in MODFLOW STO

live_pointer_contract.timing: overwrite after MODFLOW initialize and before prepare_time_step/prepare_solve

gates: Unreplaced control ends at 8.066666666666666 m within 1e-10 m.
Runtime replacement reads back SY=0.20 and ends at 8.05 m within 1e-10 m.
Replacement plus duplicate API storage ends at 8.025 m within 1e-10 m.
The replacement case closes the one-volume geometric mass oracle while the duplicate case reproduces the DSW23 physical-volume deficit signature.
interpretation_rules: This proves a storage-replacement coupling mechanism is executable through the MODFLOW API/XMI surface.
It does not prove SWAP5 should use this mechanism in production.
The adversarial case shows why replacing STO and also publishing the same physical storage response as an additive API term is inconsistent for a coextensive h-link.
